title: Odell Beckham Jr Tells Mavs Mark Cuban After Mavs Game, "I'm Giving You 15 Assists" [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Dallas Cowboys played host to free agent wide receiver on Monday at The Star.

According to the team, Beckham met with the Cowboys' medical personnel on Monday and took a medical examination. He's not expected to work out with the Cowboys, but he didn't with the other teams he met.

Josina Anderson shared that his visit with the Cowboys is expected to last through Tuesday.

Beckham met with the owners of the Cowboys, including Jerry Jones, Stephen Jones, Will McClay, executive vice president of team player staff, and head coach Mike McCarthy.

On Monday night, he sat courtside in Jerry Jones' seats alongside Dallas Cowboys Micah Parsons, Trevon Diggs, and Corey Gamble. 

After the game Beckham Jr met with Mark Cuban and Corey Gamble asked Mark, 'Can you help him make the right decision.

Gamble added, "He said [If] he can play for you for one week, he's coming."

"I'm giving you 15 assists," said Beckham Jr.

"Yeah, right," said Cuban.

Luka Doncic was also asked about his recruit attempt of Beckham.

“I tried. After the game I saw him, so hopefully…go Cowboys, said Doncic.
